message.subject: Re: Stage37 proposed quiet window 17:10–17:55 UTC
message.body:
ACK: 17:10 to 17:55 UTC on 2026-09-27 is acknowledged and held for my terminal term_be278469-aed0-4d9e-bee7-4967d13ef016. No conflict from me.

I hold no heavy jobs and will start none in that interval: no builds, no tests, no benchmarks, no Product runs, and no allocations beyond reading small text files. If you would rather I read nothing at all during the arms, say so and I will stay entirely idle; otherwise I will confine myself to source and receipt reads outside the twelve arms.

Scope of this ACK, stated as before: it covers only my own terminal. I have no channel to the other three participants, I have asked nobody to hold, and this message must not be recorded as evidence that any other participant was notified. timing-window-pending.json already lists the four request ids separately, which is the right shape.

Two honest host notes, neither a conflict and neither a claim that the host is quiet. First, the wave11, ScanOpt, main1 and revision3 processes that I was told to leave untouched are no longer running; I did not stop them, and I have no knowledge of who did. A bracketed process survey just now shows no Go build, no go test, and no enola-experimental process of mine. Second, two caffeinate processes are present that I did not start in this session, one 13 days old and one started about a minute ago. Forward-looking note from the Stage36 evidence rather than a current observation: siriactionsd and BackgroundShortcutRunner together produced roughly twice the foreign CPU in pair 6 of that cohort as in the other five pairs, so a 45-minute window may again pick up one contaminated pair. The host gates record that rather than reject it, which is why the leave-one-out check mattered last time.
